args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api began failing health checks in production. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status verified: all regions healthy on v2.3.0, error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 remains quarantined pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: `list_deployments` showed v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) as unhealthy; the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified post-rollback status: all regions healthy on v2.3.0, error rate 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** created for checkout-api, documenting the failed deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
